svg.title: Spead AI Pro for WIKA: how work flows
svg.desc: 1. Create the tender project (Tender staff): Adds the project with employer, tender number and location under Knowledge, Tender packages. 2. Upload the package (Tender staff): Uploads the agreement and appendices as PDF and marks each file as agreement or appendix with its letter. 3. Let Spead read (System): The reader extracts text, splits clauses and sub-items, runs OCR on scanned pages and indexes the files for search. 4. Start the review (Tender staff): Chooses Review a tender package in Doc Assistant and sees the plan: files, pages and an estimated time. 5. Fill and check (System): The job reads files and tables, drafts each item, then checks every quote against the files. 6. Review flagged items (Tender staff): Opens items marked for checking, compares them with the source page and edits or approves them. 7. Approve or return (Tender and contract manager): Approves the submitted review or returns it with notes; files are locked while a review is submitted or approved. 8. Export and ask (Tender team): Exports the review to Word, PDF or Excel and asks follow-up questions about the package with citations.
svg.text: From the first step to the last, and who does what.
